items.so_what_text: Make Privacy-Preserving Analytics a near-term focus for AAFCU: a scoped investment here would lift it from 1.5 toward the 3.3 peer benchmark and move the institution to parity with peers. Because it underpins the day-to-day experience customers have across every channel, the gains reach well beyond this single capability [E-140].
items.title: CRM Modernization — Salesforce FSC + Data Cloud + MuleSoft
items.what_text: Oracle Siebel v22.1 on OCI PaaS confirmed (, Daniel Fernandez Davila AAFCU Data Analyst). Four data silos: SavvyMoney+ARCU+Siebel+Episys. No CDP. ceiling at level 2. $42M SavvyMoney ROI is the personalization ceiling without data unification. Salesforce Financial Services Cloud + Data Cloud + MuleSoft. Unify 4 data silos into member 360. MuleSoft API integration to Episys (core) + ARCU (warehouse) + SavvyMoney (credit signals). Einstein Next Best Action on unified member profile. In Zennify's assessment Privacy-Preserving Analytics scores 1.5 out of 5, versus a typical 3.3 at comparable institutions [E-136].
items.why_text: At 1.5 out of 5, Privacy-Preserving Analytics sits 1.8 points below the 3.3 typically seen at comparable institutions — an early-stage capability with the widest distance to close. Closing that distance would strengthen the day-to-day experience customers have across every channel, so progress here compounds across the rest of the business [E-110, E-136].
